major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press Metamorphosis only after Eye Beam is on cooldown and your Immolation Aura charges and Demonsurge empowerments are spent, since it resets them all.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 200166 is the id logs carry for the Havoc Metamorphosis cast (CAST in 5/5 parses); the guide cites 191427, which is castable per tooltip but was never observed as a cast. Cooldown 120s from the 191427 row; 162264 is the self aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Eye Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire Eye Beam the moment it is ready with Vengeful Retreat a global earlier for Initiative, and press it as Abyssal Gaze inside Metamorphosis.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base and tooltip cooldown is 30s; Cycle of Hatred shaves up to 10s off once stacked, which the guide quotes as a 20s cooldown. Abyssal Gaze (452497) is the Fel-Scarred in-Metamorphosis cast and shares this cooldown, so it is deliberately not a separate entry.

major_cooldowns.name: Essence Break
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Essence Break on cooldown and spend its whole window on Death Sweep and Annihilation, but hold it for after Eye Beam when Eye Beam is up within 4 seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258860 is the cast id; 320338 is the enemy debuff.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast The Hunt when Eye Beam is within 10 seconds of ready so Eternal Hunt doubles that Eye Beam.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Never sit on both charges of Immolation Aura, and dump them before Metamorphosis because it resets them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258920 is the observed Havoc cast id for every charge; A Fire Inside adds a second charge and cuts 6s, and the in-Metamorphosis version Consuming Fire (452487) was never observed as its own cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it on its own keybind early in the opener before Eye Beam, never macroed into Metamorphosis.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Combat potion named by the guide's opener and the APL potion line; gated so a player on a different potion is not read as never using one.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press your on-use trinket with the potion at the start of the burst, never macroed into Metamorphosis.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket singled out by the APL precombat variables and cast in 4/5 parses; gated because trinket choice varies.

rule.description: Open Eye Beam into Essence Break, then Metamorphosis
rule.action: Lead with Eye Beam and Essence Break, spend the window on Death Sweep, then press Metamorphosis.

rule.description: Vengeful Retreat before every Eye Beam
rule.action: Retreat first so Initiative is up when Eye Beam goes out.

rule.description: Spend Immolation Aura charges before Metamorphosis
rule.action: Dump your Immolation Aura charges first, because Metamorphosis resets them.

rule.description: The Hunt paired into your next Eye Beam
rule.action: Send The Hunt so your next Eye Beam follows it and takes the Eternal Hunt damage.

rule.description: Hold Essence Break until after Eye Beam
rule.action: Let Eye Beam go out first and break right after it, so the window is not spent channeling.

rule.description: Felblade only when Fury has room
rule.action: Spend down with Annihilation or Chaos Strike first, then use Felblade to refill.
